name: Number And Sum Of Transactions 2
definition: Set of elements providing the total sum of entries.

NumberOfEntries.name: Number Of Entries
NumberOfEntries.definition: Number of individual entries included in the report.

Sum.name: Sum
Sum.definition: Total of all individual entries included in the report.

TotalNetEntryAmount.name: Total Net Entry Amount
TotalNetEntryAmount.definition: Resulting amount of the netted amounts for all debit and credit entries.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the total net entry amount is a credit or a debit amount.

DebitCreditIndicatorGuideline.definition: DebitCreditIndicator should be present when TotalNetEntryAmount is present.
